description: Shared base for all TorstenAmshove repositories (Mend Renovate App, free tier, GitHub Free).
Rationale for every rule: README.md of this repository.

packageRules.description: Majors: always a separate PR, never auto-merged. The PR (with assignee) is what triggers a GitHub notification.
Patch, digest and pin updates are auto-merged by Renovate once all PR checks are green.
npm: longer release age as supply-chain protection (compromised releases are usually pulled within days).
npm minor updates: one grouped PR per week. Auto-merge is opted into per repository.
pip minor updates: one grouped PR per week. Auto-merge is opted into per repository.
GitHub Actions: one monthly PR for all non-major updates (auto-merged), one for majors (manual). Release workflows ignore .github/**, so these never trigger a release.
Runtime versions in workflows (setup-python/setup-node) are owned by the repository presets/configs that need them.
